statement_zh: 意式浓缩放大醇厚度与油脂，前段高挥发花果香被压缩。
statement_en: Espresso amplifies body and oils; the volatile floral and fruit top notes are compressed.

statement_zh: 冷萃抑制低挥发酸，酸质与花香偏弱，甜感与醇厚更突出。
statement_en: Cold brew suppresses the low-volatility acids: less acidity and floral lift, more sweetness and body.

statement_zh: 手冲快萃优先释放前段高挥发花香与单体果酸。
statement_en: Pour-over releases the early, volatile floral and fruit acids first.

statement_zh: 浸泡式萃取带入更多油脂与细粉，醇厚度上升，干净度下降。
statement_en: Immersion brewing carries more oils and fines: more body, less clarity.

statement_zh: 浅烘保留更多绿原酸与高挥发香气，酸质与花果香突出。
statement_en: Light roasts keep more chlorogenic acids and volatile aromatics: acidity and floral-fruit notes lead.

statement_zh: 中浅烘保留花果酸质，同时开始形成焦糖化甜感。
statement_en: Medium-light roasts keep the floral-fruit acidity while caramelisation sweetness begins.

statement_zh: 中烘平衡酸质与美拉德产物，坚果与焦糖增强。
statement_en: Medium roasts balance acidity against Maillard products: nut and caramel rise.

statement_zh: 中深烘美拉德产物占比高，醇厚度、巧克力与苦感上升，酸质下降。
statement_en: Medium-dark roasts are Maillard-dominated: body, chocolate and bitterness rise, acidity falls.

statement_zh: 深烘绿原酸大量降解，焦糖苦与烟熏占主导。
statement_en: Dark roasts degrade most chlorogenic acids: caramelised bitterness and smoke dominate.

statement_zh: 极深烘以碳化与烟熏为主，品种与产地特征基本被覆盖。
statement_en: Very dark roasts are carbonised and smoky; origin and variety character is mostly covered.

statement_zh: 水洗去胶质快，内源有机酸突出：干净度高、柑橘、花香、高酸。
statement_en: Washed processing removes mucilage quickly; the bean's own organic acids stand out: clean, citrus, floral, high acidity.

statement_zh: 日晒让果肉糖分长时间发酵渗入豆内，还原糖与游离氨基酸升高：果酱、热带水果、高甜、波本感。
statement_en: Natural processing lets fruit sugars ferment into the seed: more reducing sugars and free amino acids — jam, tropical fruit, high sweetness.

statement_zh: 厌氧发酵产生大量乳酸与外源酯类：酸奶、厌氧酒香、极高识别度。
statement_en: Anaerobic fermentation produces lactic acid and exogenous esters: yoghurt, winey notes, very distinctive.

statement_zh: 蜜处理保留部分果胶发酵，甜感与醇厚介于水洗与日晒之间。
statement_en: Honey processing keeps part of the mucilage: sweetness and body between washed and natural.

statement_zh: 脱因工艺去除部分前体物质，香气强度整体下降。
statement_en: Decaffeination removes some precursors; aroma intensity drops overall.

statement_zh: 瑰夏基因型花香与柑橘酸质上限极高，醇厚度偏轻。
statement_en: The Gesha genotype has a very high ceiling for floral and citrus acidity with a lighter body.

statement_zh: 波本甜感与平衡度好，焦糖与红果常见。
statement_en: Bourbon is sweet and balanced; caramel and red fruit are typical.

statement_zh: SL28/SL34 以黑加仑与明亮柑橘酸质著称。
statement_en: SL28/SL34 are known for blackcurrant and bright citric acidity.

statement_zh: 埃塞原生种以茉莉花、柑橘与蓝莓（日晒）为标志。
statement_en: Ethiopian landraces are marked by jasmine, citrus and, when natural, blueberry.

statement_zh: 铁皮卡干净、甜感柔和，醇厚适中。
statement_en: Typica is clean and gently sweet with moderate body.

statement_zh: 罗布斯塔前体糖分低、绿原酸与咖啡因高：苦感与醇厚重，花果弱。
statement_en: Robusta has low sugar precursors and high chlorogenic acid and caffeine: heavy bitterness and body, little floral-fruit.

statement_zh: 浅烘焙保留了绿原酸与高挥发性花果香，V60 快萃优先释放了前段极性酸质。
statement_en: Light roast preserves volatile florals and fruit acids, and V60 fast extraction targets these front-end acids.

statement_zh: 中深烘的美拉德产物在意式高压下被油脂放大：黑巧、焦糖与厚重口感主导，酸质退到后段。
statement_en: Medium-dark Maillard products are amplified by espresso pressure and oils: dark chocolate, caramel and weight lead; acidity retreats.

statement_zh: 冷萃压低了浅烘的低挥发酸，花香减弱、甜感与茶感更清晰。
statement_en: Cold brew flattens the light roast's low-volatility acids: less floral lift, clearer sweetness and tea-like body.

statement_zh: 浅烘 + 水洗保留了柠檬酸与高极性酯类：柑橘、茉莉与干净的酸质。
statement_en: Light roast plus washed processing keeps citric acid and polar esters: citrus, jasmine and clean acidity.

statement_zh: 浅烘 + 日晒把发酵进豆内的果糖与酯类完整保留：蓝莓、果酱与高甜。
statement_en: Light roast plus natural processing keeps the fermented fruit sugars and esters: blueberry, jam and high sweetness.

statement_zh: 中深烘 + 厌氧本应呈现较强的黑巧与发酵感；若你尝到更高的酸质，通常是冲煮水温偏低使后段大分子苦酚萃取不足。
statement_en: Medium-dark plus anaerobic should read as dark chocolate and fermentation; a brighter acidity usually means the brew ran cool and under-extracted the late bitter phenolics.
